description: This file defines classes for handling completion of responses asynchronously in the Orleans serialization system, specifically implementing IResponseCompletionSource for responses with or without a result type, including methods for setting results, exceptions, resetting, and converting to ValueTask.

classes.name: ResponseCompletionSource
classes.description: A fulfillable promise that provides a Response result asynchronously, implementing IResponseCompletionSource, IValueTaskSource<Response> and IValueTaskSource.

classes.name: ResponseCompletionSource<TResult>
classes.description: A generic fulfillable promise for a Response with a specific result type, implementing IResponseCompletionSource, IValueTaskSource<TResult>, and IValueTaskSource.

methods.name: AsValueTask
methods.description: Converts the completion source to a ValueTask<Response> or ValueTask<TResult> for asynchronous awaiting.

methods.name: AsVoidValueTask
methods.description: Returns a ValueTask representing the completion with no result.

methods.name: GetStatus
methods.description: Gets the current status of the asynchronous operation based on the token.

methods.name: OnCompleted
methods.description: Registers a continuation action to be called upon completion.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the completion source for reuse and returns it to the pool.

methods.name: SetException
methods.description: Completes the promise with an exception.

methods.name: SetResult
methods.description: Completes the promise with a result.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Completes the ResponseCompletionSource with a Response value or Response<TResult>.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the asynchronous operation, resetting if the token is valid.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Completes the ResponseCompletionSource with a Response<TResult> value.

methods.name: SetInvalidCastException
methods.description: Helper method to throw and set an InvalidCastException if unable to cast result to TResult.
